paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card asks: “How could the fictional trial limit its effects, and what observation would justify stopping or returning to the existing method?” Read alone or discuss the fictional reader without publishing answers, proving a need or requesting confirmation. Agreement, additional support and higher scores are never completion conditions.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与讨论卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，原观察均可跳过。本版保留费马原创题本的二十四条中文陈述及五级选项，新增英文译文和明示不计分。结合近期可回忆的普通安排，不擅加四周窗口。六主题各四条直接计入，无反向；1至5是符合程度，3保留“不确定或视情况”，是数值回答，不改成有时、中立或缺答。无法给数值或不愿答可选不计分，不补零、中点或低值。二十四项均需回应；每主题四项数字齐全才呈现原始和4—20与原始和除以四的准确均分，保留四分之一步长、显示两位小数。1、1、1、2合5，准确均分1.25；2、4、3、4合13，为3.25，不再舍入为一位小数。任一不计分仅使所属主题暂缺显示，其余完整主题和六篇全文保留。完整不证明可靠，两位小数不证明心理精度。六组是未验证为独立因子的编辑主题，不跨组排名、相加、相减、派型或选最深欲望；同数不证明同等需要，重测变化不证明改善。框架无已建立的信效度、常模、预测能力或中英等值，不能读取潜意识或评估能力、道德、身份、录用及关系去留。虚构讨论不需真实经历、他人配合、联系、公开试验或提高分数。听者可以不参与，任何请求都保留拒绝。页面内存、自选24小时标签页草稿及完成、重测、退出清除保持不变，复制不含答案、原始和或个人均分。
paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial authored these additions. Reading alone suffices; existing observations are optional. This edition retains twenty-four original Chinese statements and five anchors, adding an English translation and an explicitly unscored option. Recall recent ordinary arrangements without imposing a four-week window. Six themes each have four direct items without reversals. Ratings 1–5 describe fit; three retains uncertainty or depending on the situation as a numeric response, not sometimes, neutrality or missingness. Inability to give a number or withholding may remain unscored without zero, midpoint or low-value replacement. All twenty-four items require responses. Each theme needs all four numbers to display a raw sum of 4–20 and its exact sum divided by four, preserving quarter steps with two decimals. Ratings 1, 1, 1, 2 sum to five and give 1.25; 2, 4, 3, 4 sum to thirteen and give 3.25. These exact means are not rounded to one decimal. One unscored answer withholds only its theme’s display; other complete themes and all six guides remain available. Completeness proves no reliability and two decimals prove no psychological precision. These editorial themes are not validated independent factors. They are never ranked, added, subtracted or used to assign a type or deepest desire. Equal numbers establish no equal needs; retake changes establish no improvement. The framework has no established reliability, validity, norms, prediction or English–Chinese equivalence and cannot read the subconscious or determine ability, morality, identity, hiring or relationship decisions. Fictional discussion needs no personal account, cooperation, contact, public experiment or score improvement. Listeners may decline, and every request leaves room for refusal. Page memory, optional 24-hour tab drafts and completion, retake or exit clearing remain unchanged; copying contains no answers, raw sums or personal means.
